CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2819 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 6f91e6d05450ba32fe1cfa102b00a9763235d412. Bus nonce: 39febcd175ca57354333bc0fd80f1e8c. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 6f91e6d05450ba32fe1cfa102b00a9763235d412`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 6f91e6d05450ba32fe1cfa102b00a9763235d412` or `Fix review: blocked 6f91e6d05450ba32fe1cfa102b00a9763235d412 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 39febcd175ca57354333bc0fd80f1e8c`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `6f91e6d05450ba32fe1cfa102b00a9763235d412` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2819 6f91e6d05450ba32fe1cfa102b00a9763235d412") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2819-39febcd1`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
FULL REVIEW of #2819 (topic r10-arch-shapes), round 4, head 6f91e6d05450ba32fe1cfa102b00a9763235d412. Round 3 blocked on claim drift (verdict comment 6403941902). Round 4 split the reason-classifier arm out to park/r10-arch-shapes-classifier, which now goes to the new group R10-ARCH-SHAPES-CLASSIFIER. Review per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA. Measure at the head; do not trust the body's figures.

Check four things:
1. Both claim files are byte-identical to origin/main. Compare them with cmp or sha256 against origin/main, not against the branch's own history.
2. The split leaves no half-arm. Nothing in the head still references, imports, tests or documents the reason-classifier arm that moved out. Grep the head for its symbols and for any test or mutant that would now fail or silently pass because of the split.
3. band_census.py is a sound harness: run it at the head, mutate what it measures and confirm it fails, and check its counts against what the body reports.
4. Every carry is routed. The body carries two items: the mutation pin for the 71 sites, and CI tests/fast. For each carry, check the destination stage named in the body exists on the roster and that nothing is dismissed without a reason. Check the carry rules in fix-review.md.

Also check that the delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2819.md is in the three-dot diff against origin/main, that the merge with origin/main is clean (git merge-tree --write-tree), and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.

Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. Its first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 6f91e6d05450ba32fe1cfa102b00a9763235d412` or `Fix review: blocked 6f91e6d05450ba32fe1cfa102b00a9763235d412`. The next line is `bus-nonce: 39febcd175ca57354333bc0fd80f1e8c`. Then your findings, each with a severity and a carry. Post the verdict as a comment on PR #2819. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce. Do not name any path under a home directory in the verdict.
